name: Kuduro batida
desc: Angolan kuduro at 140: a hard four-on-the-floor slammed with broken tom-and-clap stabs in the gaps — the Luanda street-party batida that Buraka Som Sistema exported. Aggressive and frantic; peak double-times into carnival stampede fills.

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ [mt mt] ~ cp ~ ~ [lt lt] ~").bank("RolandTR808").speed(${tomspd}).gain(${gain}*.55), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.45).room(.18), s("[~ hh]*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.22, ${gain}*.4).fast(4))).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("<[~ [mt mt] ~ cp ~ ~ [lt lt] ~] [[mt mt] ~ cp ~ [lt lt] ~ [mt mt mt] ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").speed(${tomspd}).gain(${gain}*.6), s("~ [cp cp] ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.5).room(.18), s("[~ hh]*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(${gain}*.26, ${gain}*.46).fast(4))).lastOf(2, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
